visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a dark grey t-shirt and denim shorts is crouching in front of a white gashapon vending machine in a bright retail environment. A young toddler in a beige t-shirt and blue shorts stands next to him, watching with interest. The man reaches for the machine's dial. (2) The man turns the dial, and a distinct orange plastic capsule rolls into the collection tray. He picks it up while looking at the boy. A second man with blonde hair and a floral shirt is visible standing in the background. (3) The scene shifts to a medium close-up of the toddler holding the orange capsule. The man in the grey t-shirt points at the capsule and interacts with the child. The background is filled with toys and store signage. (4) The man takes the capsule back and begins to pry it open with his hands. The child leans in closely to see what is inside. (5) The man successfully opens the capsule, revealing a small purple character figure. They both examine the toy. The man gestures excitedly while talking to the child. (6) The toddler looks up at the camera or the man, smiling. Bright yellow and purple text overlays appear on the screen as they continue their conversation.
